notes.title: PIZDEANU FOREST UPDATE
notes.content:
PIZDEANU FOREST IS A NEW STORY MODE!
You play as a man who crashes his cart into the PIZDEANU FOREST.
Trying to find some medicine, you encounter the BEAST. From there you try to escape.
A short story which was requested!
ENJOY!
